svg.aria-label: OmaDock: a dithered terminal command strip with dot-matrix application glyphs
svg.title: OmaDock
svg.desc: The dock is a single command strip. A dot-matrix prompt opens the line, each application is a dot-matrix glyph beside a lowercase command label, and an ordered-dither texture gathers along the bottom edge. A run of accent dots marks the focused application, three dim dots mark one merely running, and a pinned application that is not running stays dim with no marker.
